=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:56-63, 78, 147-151 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The marker reader accepts clean markers from any OWNER, MEMBER, COLLABORATOR, or `[bot]` account rather than verifying the pipeline account.
  WHY: A non-pipeline commenter can forge a clean marker for the current head and permit an unaudited merge; severity ranges from major to blocker, so critical reflects the highest rating.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:147-151 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The gate accepts any historical clean marker for the current head instead of requiring the latest marker for that head to be clean.
  WHY: An earlier clean marker can override a later findings or failed result for the same head and allow auto-merge.
- .github/workflows/security-audit.yml:312-316 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The broad `skipping` log match converts runs where no audit occurred, including `SECURITY_AUDIT_ENABLED=false`, into zero findings and a clean marker.
  WHY: The review gate can accept that marker and permit an unaudited merge; reviewers rated this major or blocker, so critical reflects the highest rating.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:166-185 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The same-head findings branch returns `awaiting_followups` before the cycle-exhaustion branch can run when the cycle limit is reached.
  WHY: The exhausted PR is not labelled or escalated, while a changed head can be labelled exhausted without auditing that head; reviewers rated this blocker or major, so critical reflects the highest rating.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:153 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The cycle-count maximum uses an awk comparison that reviewers report can miscount double-digit cycle values.
  WHY: If the count is capped at 9, exhaustion detection can fail when the configured limit exceeds 9; severity ranges from nit to major, so high reflects the highest rating, with minimax disputing whether ordinary numeric strings trigger the behavior.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:249-272 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root hook copy lacks shell-redirection parsing present in the workflow template copy.
  WHY: The hook copies diverge, causing the cited parity and redirection tests to fail and CI to stop before the single-issue security-pass test step.
- .github/workflows/security-audit.yml:41-45, 302 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The workflow omits `actions: write` while the report step can fall back to `GITHUB_TOKEN` to redispatch the review workflow.
  WHY: That fallback token cannot dispatch without the permission, so the result is not redispatched; reviewers rated this major or nit, so high reflects the highest rating.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:203-218, 175-176 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: If adding the `ai:security-pass-failed` label fails, the PR remains held without the label needed by the reported escalation path.
  WHY: Recovery depends on another review event retrying the label write, so the PR can remain stuck if no such event arrives.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:177-180 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Failure to post the exhaustion comment is silently ignored.
  WHY: The PR can be labelled as failed without an in-PR explanation until a later event retries the comment.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5598-5604 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The security-pass step relies on `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR` exported by an earlier step but does not declare that dependency in its own `env:` block.
  WHY: Reordering steps or breaking the export chain can make the script fall back to checkout scripts instead of verified workflow-support scripts.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:187-192 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The redispatch uses `--ref "${default_branch}"` rather than the PR head branch.
  WHY: The audit can check out the default branch instead of the PR commit, making its result irrelevant to the PR changes.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:222-228 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The temporary comments file is removed only on the success path.
  WHY: Failure or interruption can leave temporary files behind on persistent self-hosted runners.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: “At MAX_SECURITY_PASS_CYCLES the PR is labelled ai:security-pass-failed for the unblock judge” / “The unblock judge takes it from there” when a PR reaches the security-pass cycle limit.
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh exhaustion handling and the workflow dispatch path for ai:security-pass-failed PRs
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh lines 173-185 only adds the label and posts a comment before returning; scripts/review_rb_judge.sh is not invoked for this label; .github/workflows/review_rb_judge_dispatch.yml is workflow_dispatch-only; review_autofix.yml has no post-exhaustion handler.
- requirement: “Findings become follow-up issues against this branch; their merges start a new review”.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/security-audit.yml or scripts/security_audit.sh
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The review reports no code configuring follow-up issue creation to target the PR head branch; without explicit branch routing, follow-ups use the default-branch tracker and their merges do not update the PR head.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:78 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: Marker validation trusts any OWNER, MEMBER, COLLABORATOR, or `[bot]` author instead of only the pipeline account.
  WHY: A trusted collaborator or bot can post a forged clean marker for the current head, causing the gate to proceed without a security audit.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:166-172, 173-185 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The `awaiting_followups` check runs before the cycle-exhaustion check.
  WHY: At the cycle limit, a findings marker for the current head prevents the exhaustion label and comment; a changed head can then be labelled exhausted without an audit.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:153 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The awk maximum comparison uses string comparison for cycle values.
  WHY: The count can be capped at 9 when `MAX_SECURITY_PASS_CYCLES` exceeds 9.
- .github/workflows/security-audit.yml:313-315 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: Any matching `skipping` line is treated as zero findings.
  WHY: An audit-disabled run can post a clean marker and permit auto-merge without an audit.
- .github/workflows/security-audit.yml:41-45, 302 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The workflow omits `actions: write` while the report step can fall back to `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
  WHY: The redispatch can fail with HTTP 403 and remain unnoticed, leaving the PR held until another event.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:203-218 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: A failed label write can leave the PR held without the failure label until another review event retries it.
  WHY: Without the label, the reported unblock-judge handling cannot recognize the PR; a failed comment post is also silently ignored.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5598-5604 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: The step depends on `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR` exported earlier but does not declare it in its own `env:` block.
  WHY: A broken export chain or reordered steps could cause fallback to scripts in the checkout directory instead of verified workflow-support scripts.

- Requirement: From the PR description: “At MAX_SECURITY_PASS_CYCLES the PR is labelled ai:security-pass-failed for the unblock judge” and from the changelog fragment: “A PR still failing after five cycles is labelled ai:security-pass-failed and handed to the unblock judge.”
  Expected change site: Either scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh (a dispatch or handler that invokes the unblock judge) or a new review_autofix.yml step that detects ai:security-pass-failed and dispatches to the unblock judge, or a review-blocked judge path that keys on the ai:security-pass-failed label.
  Evidence of absence: The exhaustion branch at lines 173-185 only adds the ai:security-pass-failed label and posts a comment before returning hold=true. No code anywhere in the diff dispatches the unblock judge, invokes scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, or triggers the existing review-blocked judge flow for PRs carrying ai:security-pass-failed. The single_issue_security_pass step in review_autofix.yml has no post-exhaustion handler. The changelog fragment says “the unblock judge takes it from here” but this PR provides no mechanism for the unblock judge to ever be invoked for this label.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
